howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From Japan to your doorstep in three simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up for $60/month ($50 membership + $10 flat shipping worldwide). No hidden fees, cancel anytime.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Each month, our Tokyo team selects 4–6 premium items around a unique theme. Standard box weight: up to 450g.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your box arrives at your door. Follow the weekly Ritual prompts to make the most of every item.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Each box contains 4–6 curated Japanese stationery items — pens, paper, washi tape, stickers, and more — centered around a monthly theme.
faq.a2: Shipping is a flat $10/month worldwide, included in your $60 total. No surprises at checkout.
faq.q3: Do I have to pay customs duties?
faq.a3: Shipments are sent DDU (Delivered Duty Unpaid). Depending on your country, you may be responsible for import duties and taxes. Most small packages clear without charges.
faq.a4: Absolutely. Cancel through your account portal anytime. You'll receive boxes through the end of your current billing period.
faq.q5: What if my items arrive damaged?
faq.a5: We'll send a free replacement. Just contact us within 14 days of delivery with photos of the damage.
faq.a6: We ship worldwide by default. In rare cases, some remote areas may need confirmation. If delivery isn't feasible, we'll work with you on an alternative or issue a full refund.
faq.a7: Boxes ship the first week of each month. Delivery takes 7–14 business days depending on your location.
faq.a8: Not yet, but gift subscriptions are coming soon!

shipping.title: Shipping & Customs
shipping.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery.
shipping.flatRateDesc: All subscriptions include worldwide shipping at a flat rate of $10/month, included in your $60 monthly total.
shipping.deliveryDesc: Boxes ship the first week of each month. Standard delivery takes 7–14 business days. Tracking is provided for all shipments.
shipping.customsDesc: All shipments are sent DDU (Delivered Duty Unpaid). You may be responsible for any import duties, taxes, or customs charges levied by your country.
shipping.coverageDesc: We ship worldwide by default. Some remote areas may require confirmation. If delivery isn't feasible, we'll offer an alternate address, delay, or full refund.
shipping.weightDesc: Standard box weight: up to 450g. Dimensions are optimized for international shipping.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using TOKI & TOMO, you agree to the following terms.
terms.subscriptionText: Your subscription renews monthly at $60 ($50 membership + $10 shipping). Cancel anytime via the Customer Portal.
terms.shippingText: We ship worldwide by default. Some remote areas may require confirmation. If delivery is not feasible, we will offer an alternate address, delay, or refund.
terms.liabilityText: TOKI & TOMO is not responsible for delays caused by carriers, customs processing, or force majeure events.
terms.changesText: We may update these terms. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. Here's how we handle your data.
privacy.collectionText: Email, name, shipping address, payment information (processed by Stripe), style preferences, and usage analytics.
privacy.usageText: To fulfill your subscription, personalize your experience, send shipping notifications, and improve our service.
privacy.sharingText: We share data only with essential service providers: Stripe (payments), Resend (email), and our shipping partners. We never sell your data.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting privacy@tokitomo.com.

replacement.title: Replacement & Refund Policy
replacement.intro: We want you to love every box.
replacement.damagedText: If items arrive damaged, contact us within 14 days with photos. We'll send replacements at no charge.
replacement.missingText: If your box is missing items, let us know within 14 days. We'll ship the missing items or provide store credit.
replacement.refundsText: We don't offer refunds for shipped boxes. If we can't deliver to your address, we'll issue a full refund.
replacement.cancelText: Cancel anytime through the Customer Portal. You'll receive all boxes through the end of your billing period.
